or a correction?

Contact the Wishly team about guide corrections, product questions, editorial feedback or website-related enquiries.

Last updated: 7 November 2026

Contact the Wishly team

For questions about Wishly Guide, product features, templates or an article correction, visit the Visit Wishly ↗. This keeps enquiries in the same support channel used by the main Wishly website.

What to include in a correction

Please include the article URL, the sentence or instruction that needs attention and—when possible—a short explanation of the correct information. Do not send passwords, payment details or other sensitive information.

Publisher and project

Wishly Guide is an information website associated with Wishly, created by RA Fahim. Visit Wishly for the main website or RA Fahim’s website for founder information.
